payload.recallText: Joe receives a letter on a snowy day as he and his sister Clara are reading and writing their correspondence.  Joe's manager of the Pittstown ball team he plays for is writing to tell him he is being considered for the draft for the St. Lois Cardinals.  Joe's mother walks in as he is pretending to warm up his arm and spills the jug of water she is carrying to water her plants as Joe knocks into her.  She asks what all the excitement is about and Joe explains to her and Clara that he is being considered for the St. Louis Cardinals and that it would mean more money for him.  Nothing is sure as of yet.  He also received a letter from one of his admirers named Mabel saying they are coming for a visit and will be on the afternoon train.  As it is snowing the timetable is uncertain.  Joe leaves for the station and the station master tells him the snow is delaying the trains.
